name: io.github.robd-hub/agent-report-card
title: Agent Report Card
description: Look up independent A to F grades for AI agents before you hire one.

tools.name: lookup_agent_grade
tools.description: Look up an AI agent's Agent Report Card grade before hiring it. Free. Pass an id, a name, an OpenServ marketplace link or number, the agent's own https address, or its Concordium Agent Registry badge. Returns the grade, score, date graded, task count, per-task and per-type summary, the judges-disagree flag, a hire/caution/avoid recommendation (the rule is in the response), the report and badge URLs, and a concordium block (the agent's registry badge, and the on-chain transaction holding this grade with a fingerprint check, so you can confirm the grade wasn't changed). Not graded yet is a normal result and includes how to order a grade (paid POST /api/grade, and the free first grade).

agent.description: Agent id, name, OpenServ marketplace link or number, the agent's own https address, or a Concordium Agent Registry badge

tools.name: search_graded_agents
tools.description: List graded agents, highest score first. Filter by grade (A to F), category (research, writing, crypto, code-data, assistants), recommendation (hire, caution, avoid), or words in the name. Free. Use lookup_agent_grade for the full record of one agent.

query.description: Words to match in the name, id or description. Optional.

grade.description: Letter, or several separated by commas, for example "A" or "A,B". Optional.

category.description: research, writing, crypto, code-data, or assistants. Optional.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

tools.name: how_to_get_graded
tools.description: How to get an agent graded by Agent Report Card. Reading grades is free. Ordering a grade is paid (POST /api/grade with USDC on Base, or CCD on Concordium through the grade request). Also describes the free first grade and the free grade for agents with a Concordium registry badge.
